item.title: Middle East Live: Iran says Trump 'betraying diplomacy' with blockade, excessive demands
item.description: An adviser to Iran's Supreme Leader ‌Mojtaba Khamenei ‌on Saturday said that US President Donald Trump was "betraying ‌diplomacy for the third ‌time" by continuing a naval blockade in the Strait of Hormuz and making what he described as excessive demands in negotiations to end the conflict. Follow our live blog for the latest updates.

item.title: Iran: Is Trump “Bored”?, Bolivia at “Breaking point” A Spanish Scandal
item.description:

item.title: Across the Middle East, Muslims Mark Eid Amid War and Crisis
item.description: From Iran to Gaza, Eid al-Adha celebrations were muted as war dragged on and shortages of food and fuel roiled the region.

item.title: Israeli troops push deeper into Lebanon, crossing the Litani river, as talks expected
item.description: In Lebanon, Israeli forces have advanced further north. Israeli Prime Minister Binyamin Netanyahu says they have crossed the Litani river - a key reference point in Southern Lebanon marking the limit of a UN-monitored zone. Despite a ceasefire, Israel and Iran-backed Hezbollah militants have continued to fight for weeks. Details by FRANCE 24 correspondent in Beirut, Renée Davis.

item.title: Netanyahu says he has directed IDF to increase control of Gaza to 70%
item.description: The expansion in control by Israel would contradict the terms of the ceasefire Israel and Hamas agreed to in October 2025.

item.title: Israel declares new 'combat zone' in southern Lebanon, orders evacuations
item.description: Israel expanded its military campaign in southern Lebanon on Wednesday, ordering residents to evacuate areas south of the Zahrani River as strikes intensified despite an April ceasefire. The escalation comes as Israeli officials seek to pressure Hezbollah while avoiding actions in Beirut that could complicate US-led diplomacy with Iran.

item.title: Israeli strikes kill dozens in southern Lebanon as Netanyahu expands ground campaign
item.description: Israeli strikes in southern Lebanon killed 31 people and wounded 40 on Tuesday, Lebanon’s health ministry said, including at least four children and three women, as Israel said it was intensifying operations despite a truce with the Iran-backed group Hezbollah.

item.title: Some Iranians abroad say they’d fight for the regime. Others want to topple it.
item.description: Members of the diaspora in Iraq, from Sunni Muslim Kurds in the north to Shiite Persians in the south, are as divided over the war as Iranians back home.

item.title: Pentagon hosts first-ever Israeli–Lebanese military talks aimed at curbing Hezbollah
item.description: Israeli and Lebanese military delegations open U.S.-brokered talks at the Pentagon focused on ceasefire enforcement and border stability amid tensions.
